name: How long does a typical kitchen remodel take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical kitchen remodel take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a kitchen remodel can vary significantly depending on its complexity and scope. A minor cosmetic update might take 2-4 weeks, while a full gut renovation with layout changes and custom cabinetry could extend to 6-12 weeks or more. Factors such as material lead times, permit approvals, and unexpected issues can also influence the timeline. Your contractor should provide a detailed schedule upfront.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen remodels typically take 2-12 weeks, depending on the project's scope, from minor updates to full renovations.
